Excellent!
Jul 2026 • Couples
We visited here twice during our stay. Our first visit during the day was just for drinks. We ordered a coffee and a smoothie, which were both great. Seems to be the normal in Vietnam, but the smoothie was milk based, which I don't normally like so much, but this one was really good. Our second visit was for dinner, and that was also excellent. We ordered a burger and loaded fries, which were both excellent. We would definitely return if back in Da Nang and would recommend for great food, with a great atmosphere.

Consistently good burgers
Aug 2026 • Family
We ate at Bikini Bottom twice 2 years ago and again during this trip to Da Nang (Aug26) - remains a great place for tasty burgers and other food. We’ve had the chicken tendies as well as burgers and both are delicious, good milkshakes as well. Price is very reasonable as well.

It has clearly become more successful and popular in the past couple years which means you may have to wait some time for a table in busier parts of the day. Also, we ate at both the Pink Church and the An Thurong branches this time and the Pink Church was a superior experience in food quality and service…both still were good.
